about_the_game:
Starship Guardian is an intense tower defense game where you play as an ingenious engineer defending your starship against relentless waves of enemies.

Your mission is to strategically place defenses and utilize advanced technology to protect your vessel from incoming threats.

Immerse yourself in a futuristic setting where every decision can mean the difference between survival and defeat.

Construct powerful turrets, deploy defensive mechanisms, and upgrade your defense as you face increasingly challenging adversaries.

The strategic gameplay and variety of enemy types will test your tactical skills and resource management.

Game Features:

Engaging tower defense mechanics

Diverse enemy waves with unique abilities

Captivating space environments

Starship Guardian is your opportunity to showcase your engineering prowess as you battle against hordes of enemies and save your space vessel.

Use your intellect and strategy to fend off all threats and become the ultimate defender of the stars!
